title: Granary — Yasnaya Polyana
visualBrief: Complete mapped granary/Житня exterior at Yasnaya Polyana: timber-supported two-storey storehouse with log lower walls, weathered vertical-board upper room, broad low hip roof over an open front gallery and an external stair descending along the front. Lower double wooden gate and upper doorway are physically recessed; short-side vent, timber posts, open rails, stringers and supported entrance/foot aprons remain simple original proxies. All four mapped outer edges anchor the house/gallery envelope. Hidden rear inventory, roof material and historic levels remain approximate. No copied signs, merchandise, inscriptions, artworks, furnishings, people, snow or photograph pixels.
